coverLetter: I'm writing to express my interest in the Founding Engineer position at Amberes. With 7+ years building production systems across SaaS and enterprise environments, I've developed a strong foundation in the exact challenges you're solving: secure access automation, identity management, and scalable infrastructure for regulated sectors.

At Delfín Motor Labs, I architected Cloudflare security layers and CI/CD automation that prevented 62% of deployment failures while reducing infrastructure response times by 52%. At BSE America, I built a CRM from scratch in an early-stage environment, implementing automated compliance workflows for Panama's financial regulations and secure AWS infrastructure. Earlier at GET, I led development of a multi-tenant system with RBAC for security-sensitive government data—directly relevant to your identity and access governance focus.

What draws me to Amberes is the opportunity to shape security automation infrastructure from the ground up. I've thrived in early-stage, high-ownership environments where I can move fast while maintaining the reliability and auditability standards enterprise customers demand. Your mission-critical platform serving financial services and regulated sectors aligns perfectly with my experience in security-sensitive, compliance-driven development.

I'm particularly excited about the hybrid London arrangement and potential US relocation path, as I'm actively seeking opportunities for international mobility. I would welcome the chance to discuss how my full-stack expertise in TypeScript, secure cloud infrastructure, and automation can contribute to Amberes' next growth phase.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to connecting.
